name: telegram-long-code-reply
description: Agent emits a single chat outbound whose text is an intro line plus a fenced python code block; the fence alone exceeds the telegram 4096-char cap. Expected: the fence-aware splitter cuts before the fence, then closes the fence at the mid-block cut (```) and reopens it with the same info string on the next chunk, producing 3 adapter deliveries that each parse with balanced fences while keeping one messages_out row.
